confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. July 2026 levels are projected from general Belgrade price knowledge. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable (beer assumed to be a 0.5 L draft). Hostel and hotel rates are least certain because summer demand and EUR-quoted rates vary widely. Cocktail and wine were estimated directly and sanity-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.5x and 1x). FX comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA homepage (as at 4pm 14 Oct 2026) and was not independently corroborated.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Central and Southeast European capitals with similar tourist price tiers, such as Sofia and Bucharest, then set to Belgrade's dinar price levels. No live listings were consulted.
